title: Compose — Explain Clause — Output Schema (compose-explain-clause)
description: Output schema for sprk_analysisaction sprk_actioncode='compose-explain-clause' (spaarkeai-compose-r2 task 040, FR-07). MIRRORS VERBATIM the outputSchema baked into infra/dataverse/actions/compose-explain-clause.action.json (the systemPrompt/schema author surface). Azure OpenAI Structured Outputs compatible: additionalProperties:false, object-level required array, no anyOf/oneOf/discriminator. Property declaration order (explanation → keyConcepts → relatedPlaybookIds) mirrors the author surface; explanation streams first so the Assistant renders the plain-language answer before the concept/id lists.
$comment-required: Object-level required array only — property-level boolean 'required' is FORBIDDEN (OpenAiFunctionSchemaValidator).

explanation.description: Plain-language explanation of the selected clause's legal effect and significance (≤1 short paragraph, ≤1500 chars). Emitted FIRST. Interprets the clause; does not restate it verbatim.

keyConcepts.description: 2-6 short concept labels a reader should understand to grasp the clause (terms, not sentences). Emitted SECOND. Empty allowed only when the selection is insufficient to interpret.

relatedPlaybookIds.description: Identifiers of matter/firm playbook entries the retrieval layer supplied that relate to this clause. Ids ONLY (never quoted content). Emitted LAST. Empty array when none supplied — never fabricated.
